# B&H Photo Video Gear Pricing and Specs Scraper

B&H Photo Video is one of the largest professional camera, audio and electronics retailers in the US. This actor turns a keyword search, a category page, a list of product IDs, or direct product URLs into structured records with price, discount, stock status, rating and — on request — full specifications.

## What this actor does

- Searches by keyword, browses one of nine product categories, looks up products by B&H product ID/SKU, or scrapes a list of product or search URLs directly
- Sorts keyword-search results by relevance, price, rating or newest arrivals (category browsing uses the category page's own default order)
- Filters by condition (new/used), price range, minimum rating and in-stock status
- Optionally visits each product's own page to pull full specifications, description and UPC, instead of just the search-card summary
- Omits any field a product listing didn't show — no empty strings or nulls in the output

## Output per product

- `title`, `url`
- `productId` — B&H's internal product ID
- `sku` — B&H item number (e.g. `CAER1001845`)
- `mfrPartNumber` — manufacturer part number
- `price` — current price in USD
- `originalPrice` — original/MSRP price, when the item is discounted
- `discountPercent` — percent off, when discounted
- `inStock`, `stockStatus` — e.g. "In Stock"
- `rating`, `reviewCount`
- `imageUrl`
- `keyFeatures[]` — bullet list of key features
- `description` — full product description, with detail enrichment or `productDetails`/`byUrl` modes
- `specs` — full specifications as key-value pairs, with detail enrichment or `productDetails`/`byUrl` modes
- `brand`, `upc`, `category` — from the product's own detail page; only present with detail enrichment or `productDetails`/`byUrl` modes
- `condition` — e.g. `USED`, `REFURB` (omitted for new items)
- `scrapedAt`

## Input

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | string | `search` | `search`, `byCategory`, `productDetails` or `byUrl` |
| `searchQuery` | string | `mirrorless camera` | Keyword or phrase to search (mode=search) |
| `category` | string | `cameras-and-camcorders` | Category to browse, one of 9 (mode=byCategory) |
| `productIds` | array | `[]` | B&H product IDs or SKUs to fetch (mode=productDetails) |
| `startUrls` | array | `[]` | B&H product or search page URLs to scrape (mode=byUrl) |
| `sortBy` | string | `relevance` | `relevance`, `priceAsc`, `priceDesc`, `topRated` or `newArrivals` (mode=search only; ignored in `byCategory`) |
| `condition` | string | `all` | `all`, `new` or `used` |
| `inStockOnly` | boolean | `false` | Only emit products currently in stock |
| `minPrice` | integer | – | Skip products priced below this, USD |
| `maxPrice` | integer | – | Skip products priced above this, USD |
| `minRating` | number | – | Only emit products rated at least this (1.0–5.0) |
| `fetchDetails` | boolean | `false` | Visit each product page for full specs and description (search/category modes); slower |
| `maxItems` | integer | `20` | Maximum number of products to emit (1–500) |

### Example: search with a price ceiling

```json
{
  "mode": "search",
  "searchQuery": "mirrorless camera",
  "maxPrice": 1500,
  "sortBy": "topRated",
  "maxItems": 20
}
```

### Example: browse a category with full specs

```json
{
  "mode": "byCategory",
  "category": "audio",
  "fetchDetails": true,
  "maxItems": 25
}
```

### Example: look up specific products by SKU

```json
{
  "mode": "productDetails",
  "productIds": ["1769090", "CAER1001845"]
}
```

### Example: scrape a list of product URLs

```json
{
  "mode": "byUrl",
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1769090-REG/canon_6052c012_eos_r100_mirrorless_camera.html"
  ]
}
```

## Use cases

- **Price tracking** — monitor a camera or lens's price and discount over time
- **Competitive retail research** — compare pricing and stock status against your own catalog
- **Gear buying research** — filter by rating, price and condition before a purchase decision
- **Catalog enrichment** — pull full specs and UPC codes into your own product database
- **Deal alerts** — scan a category sorted by price for newly discounted items

## FAQ

**Does this need a B&H account or API key?**
No — this actor reads B&H's public website and needs no login or key.

**Is this affiliated with B&H Photo Video?**
No. This is an independent actor intended for research and competitive-intelligence use; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by B&H Photo Video.

**What does `fetchDetails` actually add?**
It visits each product's own page to pull the full description, specification table and UPC, rather than relying on the search-result card's shorter summary — useful when you need specs, not just price and rating.

**Why is a product missing `price` or `rating`?**
Newly listed products sometimes have no public price yet, and unrated products simply don't have enough reviews for a rating; both fields are left out rather than shown as zero.

**What's the difference between `productDetails` and `byUrl`?**
`productDetails` looks up products by their B&H product ID or SKU. `byUrl` instead takes full product or search page URLs — useful when you already have links rather than IDs.

**How many products can one run return?**
Up to 500, set by `maxItems`; for a larger dataset, run the actor again with a different query or category.

**How current is the pricing and stock data?**
Each run reads the live B&H site, so price, discount and stock status reflect what's currently shown.
